subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, a `cli.tui.deliver` default, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the chosen canonical config surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an intentional per-session flag and close or document the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change the CLI default
options.body: Make delivery on by default with an explicit opt-out only if maintainers accept the compatibility and message-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the chosen canonical config surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI surface traces to steipete's feature history and the remaining question is mainly product/default policy for that surface.
